text: FIX `RxStorageInstance.bulkWrite()` emitted an `INSERT` or `UPDATE` change event for a row with a new attachment without `data` and threw `ensureNotFalsy() is falsy` when that row was the only one of the write. `categorizeBulkWriteRows()` now throws the error `AT5` so that the whole `bulkWrite()` call rejects, no document of that write is stored and no event is emitted. The per-document write error with status `510` and the type `RxStorageWriteErrorAttachment` are removed
